deskyard status: show the environment's name, state, image and screen

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] status [--json]

Shows which environment the command talks to and its state, image and screen
size.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: "key: value" lines; with --json an object

Examples:
  deskyard -e alice status

Where: inside an environment it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen environment (-e ENV)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
